sentences.en: Don't get it twisted.
sentences.zh: 别把事情想歪了。

sentences.en: No matter who you are as the actor, if there's something cool.
sentences.zh: 不管你作为演员是什么身份，只要有很酷的项目。

sentences.en: Yeah, you want to do it.
sentences.zh: 是的，你就会想去演。

sentences.en: If you're a part of something cool, you definitely want to do it.
sentences.zh: 如果你是某个酷炫项目的一部分，你绝对会想加入。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It's also cool to be in on the ground floor of something.
sentences.zh: 能参与一个项目的起步阶段也是件很酷的事。

sentences.en: Like don't wait until it's like help make it a hit.
sentences.zh: 就像别等到它火了才加入，去帮它成为爆款。

sentences.en: You know what I mean?
sentences.zh: 你知道我的意思吗？

sentences.en: Like lend your whatever power you have to kind of burnish the thing and be a part of something like before, you know, help turn it into what it became.
sentences.zh: 就像贡献出你的任何影响力去给它镀金，在它成为后来的样子之前，成为其中的一部分，你知道的，帮助它蜕变。

sentences.en: And I think you did that for us.
sentences.zh: 我觉得你为我们做到了这一点。

sentences.en: Real quick, Craig, just so people watching along or people who maybe haven't seen the episode in a while, just give us your kind of armchair summary of what this episode was.
sentences.zh: 简单说吧，克雷格，为了让正在观看的观众，或者可能有一阵子没看这一集的观众了解一下，给我们大致总结一下这一集讲了什么吧。

sentences.en: Yeah, this is where Robin meets Barney's brother and everybody else knows that Barney's brother is gay and black, except Robin.
sentences.zh: 好，这一集讲的是罗宾遇到了巴尼的兄弟，除了罗宾外，大家都知道巴尼的兄弟是个同性恋且是黑人。

sentences.en: And he comes to town and comes bursting through the door.
sentences.zh: 他来到镇上，砰地一声推门而入。

sentences.en: And Robin's like, oh, I did not know that.
sentences.zh: 罗宾当时就想，哦，我以前真不知道。

sentences.en: And basically comes in and takes them all out on the town at this moment where everybody has coupled up except Barney.
sentences.zh: 他基本上就是一进门，在大家都成双成对、只剩巴尼单身的时刻，把他们全都带出去嗨皮。

sentences.en: It's really an episode about Barney's loneliness and vulnerability and the fact that the one person he still feels so connected to is his brother.
sentences.zh: 这其实是一集关于巴尼的孤独、脆弱，以及他依然觉得跟自己联系最紧密的人就是他兄弟的剧集。

sentences.en: But the big reveal along the way is that his brother has committed the ultimate cardinal sin, according to Barney,
sentences.zh: 但这一集过程中的最大反转是，根据巴尼的观点，他的兄弟犯了一条终极重罪，

sentences.en: which is falling in love and getting in a couple and he's engaged.
sentences.zh: 那就是坠入爱河、进入一段两性关系，而且他订婚了。

sentences.en: And so there's this huge reveal and Barney feels so betrayed.
sentences.zh: 所以这就有了这个巨大的反转，巴尼觉得受到了极大的背叛。

sentences.en: And Barney has to learn to accept that his brother is going to get married.
sentences.zh: 巴尼不得不学会接受他的兄弟要结婚这件事。

sentences.en: The worst thing that could happen to anybody.
sentences.zh: 这对任何人来说都是可能发生的最糟糕的事情。

sentences.en: I would say the central joke of the episode is that except for being black and being gay, he is like Barney in every other way.
sentences.zh: 我想这一集的核心笑点在于，除了是个黑人且是同性恋之外，他在其他任何方面都跟巴尼一模一样。

sentences.en: Which was so great.
sentences.zh: 这真是太棒了。

sentences.en: Barney considers, I think, James to be his lifelong wingman.
sentences.zh: 巴尼认为，我觉得，詹姆斯是他一生的僚机。

sentences.en: Like if Ted deserts him, Marshall deserts him, he will always have James to roll through life and roll through the clubs with.
sentences.zh: 就像如果特德抛弃了他，马歇尔抛弃了他，他永远都还有詹姆斯陪着他一起闯荡生活、混迹夜店。

sentences.en: And I wrote you this little ditty to sing to you in New York City.
sentences.zh: 我为你写了这首小曲，打算在纽约唱给你听。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Dr. Mary Claire Haver, board certified OBGYN and menopause specialiSt.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是玛丽·克莱尔·海弗医生，我是美国妇产科医学会认证的妇产科医师兼绝经期专家。

sentences.en: My podcast, Unpaused, is the place for bold, unfiltered conversations about what it really takes for women to thrive in the second half of life.
sentences.zh: 我的播客《Unpaused》是一个充满大胆、直言不讳的对话的平台，探讨女性如何在人生的后半程真正绽放光彩。

sentences.en: Every week, I sit down with medical experts and leading voices to talk about the health issues that matter moSt.
sentences.zh: 每周，我都会与医学专家和行业翘楚坐在一起，讨论那些最重大的健康议题。

sentences.en: Because Unpaused isn't just about the years you live, but how well you live them.
sentences.zh: 因为《Unpaused》不仅仅关乎你的寿命，更关乎你的生活品质。

sentences.en: Listen and follow Unpaused with me, Dr. Mary Claire Haver, wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 欢迎在各大播客平台订阅并关注由我——玛丽·克莱尔·海弗医生主持的《Unpaused》。

sentences.en: And now, back to the show.
sentences.zh: 现在，我们言归正传。

sentences.en: Yeah, I loved your guys' connection in that episode, Wayne.
sentences.zh: 对，韦恩，我很喜欢你们俩在那一集里的默契。

sentences.en: And another thing that was funny about how young our series was, is we were having you come in and be like,
sentences.zh: 还有一件事很有意思，就是我们剧集刚开播时，我们让你来演的时候就好像是，

sentences.en: okay, you're going to be gay, black Barney.
sentences.zh: 好吧，你要演一个同性恋、黑人版的巴尼。

sentences.en: Go.
sentences.zh: 开始吧。

sentences.en: And there was only one season of Barney.
sentences.zh: 而且《老爸老妈浪漫史》当时才播第一季。

sentences.en: It's not like you were coming in season eight to be like, yeah, I know what the Barney thing is.
sentences.zh: 又不是说你到第八季才来，好像你早就知道巴尼是个什么样的人似的。

sentences.en: There wasn't that much Barney, but you had to come in and be like,
sentences.zh: 当时关于巴尼的背景还不多，但你一上来就得，

sentences.en: reveal that you had taught Barney so much.
sentences.zh: 展现出你其实教过巴尼很多东西。

sentences.en: You were his big brother.
sentences.zh: 你是他的大哥。

sentences.en: You had to sort of out-Barney, Barney, but in your own completely different way.
sentences.zh: 你得在某种程度上比巴尼更“巴尼”，但又要完全展现出你自己的风格。

sentences.en: What did that feel like coming in and having to hit all of those notes?
sentences.zh: 刚进剧组就要把所有这些情绪都拿捏到位，当时是什么感觉？

sentences.en: It was one of those things that, because luckily, like I said, I'd watch the show.
sentences.zh: 其实还好，因为幸运的是，就像我说的，我看过这部剧。

sentences.en: But rarely do you get the opportunity that someone says,
sentences.zh: 但你很少有机会能遇到这种情况：别人对你说，

sentences.en: come in and do something very specific to what the other actor's doing.
sentences.zh: 来吧，演一个与另一个演员的风格高度契合但又很独特的角色。

sentences.en: So in a way, the pressure was off because I knew what the legendary thing was.
sentences.zh: 所以在某种程度上，压力反而小了，因为我知道传奇人物巴尼是什么样的。

sentences.en: But also now I have to also be myself, that I've got to make James his own guy so that you guys know what he is.
sentences.zh: 但同时我又必须做我自己，我得让詹姆斯拥有他鲜明的个人特色，好让你们知道他是个什么样的人。

sentences.en: So that was cool.
sentences.zh: 所以这真的很酷。

sentences.en: And I think, I definitely think, I mean, like, not to blow smoke, but like you guys, the writing, it was there.
sentences.zh: 而且我真的觉得，我是说，并非商业互吹，但你们的剧本确实写得太棒了。

sentences.en: And then you just are able to take it and go to the other place with it.
sentences.zh: 然后你就能顺着剧本的基调，把它演绎到另一个高度。

sentences.en: And then working with Neil was so great because I already knew Neil and we'd worked together.
sentences.zh: 而且和尼尔合作非常棒，因为我之前就认识尼尔，我们合作过。

sentences.en: So we had a rapport.
sentences.zh: 所以我们很合得来。

sentences.en: What had you done?
sentences.zh: 你们之前合作过什么？

sentences.en: I was going to ask you that.
sentences.zh: 我正想问你呢。

sentences.en: I don't remember what you had done.
sentences.zh: 我不记得你以前做过什么了。

sentences.en: And I'd, A, been a fan of Neil's and I'd done like, you know, those specials when you get together and you, and...
sentences.zh: 而且我A，一直是尼尔的粉丝，我参加过那种，你知道的，大家聚在一起的慈善晚会之类的，然后……

sentences.en: The Jerry Lewis telethon.
sentences.zh: 杰瑞·刘易斯的慈善募捐晚会。

sentences.en: Yes, it was like those things, not the actual telethon.
sentences.zh: 对，就是那种活动，不是真正的募捐晚会本身。

sentences.en: But something like that.
sentences.zh: 但类似那种吧。

sentences.en: But I did something with him and we crossed paths and we just had a great time talking.
sentences.zh: 我跟他一起参加过一个活动，我们有过交集，聊天聊得很开心。

sentences.en: So I felt no weirdness when we met.
sentences.zh: 所以我们见面时我一点也没有觉得尴尬或生疏。

sentences.en: It was so welcoming and the ramp was there.
sentences.zh: 大家都非常热情，衔接得很自然。

sentences.en: I said, all right, well, let me just do what I do and see if you guys like it.
sentences.zh: 我告诉自己，好吧，那我就做我擅长的事，看看你们喜不喜欢。

sentences.en: And I remember loving that first scene with the suit and being able to come in and talk about the suit.
sentences.zh: 我记得我很喜欢那场关于西装的戏，刚出场就能聊聊西装的话题。

sentences.en: And he's like, hey, the high five, is that back?
sentences.zh: 然后他说，嘿，击掌这个动作，现在又流行回来了吗？

sentences.en: And that whole thing.
sentences.zh: 诸如此类的内容。

sentences.en: Give me five.
sentences.zh: 击个掌吧。

sentences.en: It was so cool.
sentences.zh: 真是酷极了。

sentences.en: You come into that scene like the Tasmanian devil from Looney Tunes.
sentences.zh: 你一进到那个场景里，就像华纳动画里的塔斯马尼亚恶魔一样。

sentences.en: You burst into that apartment and just take it over.
sentences.zh: 你冲进那个公寓，直接把全场掌控了。

sentences.en: It is so great.
sentences.zh: 这太棒了。

sentences.en: And that like Wyoming speech, we're all going out.
sentences.zh: 还有那段关于怀俄明的台词，我们都要出去了。

sentences.en: I forget if that's a later scene, but you give the speech about like people in Wyoming.
sentences.zh: 我忘了那是不是后面的一场戏，但你发表了一段关于怀俄明州当地人的演讲。

sentences.en: We need to do this for people in basements in Wyoming.
sentences.zh: 我们需要为怀俄明州地下室里的人们做这件事。

sentences.en: We're young.
sentences.zh: 我们还年轻。

sentences.en: We're alive.
sentences.zh: 我们还活着。

sentences.en: We're in New York City.
sentences.zh: 我们在纽约市。

sentences.en: Get out here.
sentences.zh: 出来吧。

sentences.en: That is a speech.
sentences.zh: 这段台词真棒。

sentences.en: That could be like an audition speech.
sentences.zh: 这听起来就像是一段试镜台词。

sentences.en: That was like a thing of beauty.
sentences.zh: 那简直堪称一件艺术品。

sentences.en: It was so much fun.
sentences.zh: 这太有趣了。

sentences.en: That is an excerptable piece, what you did there.
sentences.zh: 你刚才说的那段话很适合摘录出来。

sentences.en: Wayne, did you do any sort of like how much fidelity did you want to have to Niels Barney?
sentences.zh: 韦恩，你有没有去研究过，或者说你希望在多大程度上还原尼尔斯·巴尼？

sentences.en: Like, did you study that or did you say, OK, I know the basic outlines of it and I'm going to make it my own?
sentences.zh: 比如，你有深入研究过，还是说，好吧，我知道它的大致轮廓，我要演绎出自己的风格？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I wanted it to be because I realized that if I was his older brother and he got some of his game from me, but we shouldn't be exactly alike.
sentences.zh: 我希望如此，因为我意识到，如果我是他的哥哥，他身上的一些门道是从我这里学来的，但我们不应该完全一模一样。

sentences.en: So I just wanted, so I just needed to play the broad strokes, especially that where it comes from.
sentences.zh: 所以我只希望，或者说我只需要把握住大致的轮廓，尤其是那些情感的来源。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah, you know, we do this, we do that, but I felt that I should have a little more maturity than he did.
sentences.zh: 哦，是的，你知道，我们做这做那，但我感觉我应该比他显得更成熟一些。

sentences.en: So I wanted to be a little more grounded.
sentences.zh: 所以我希望表现得更沉稳一点。

sentences.en: So I did think about that as the scenes went on.
sentences.zh: 所以在剧情推进的过程中，我确实考虑过这一点。

sentences.en: And like I said, so much of it was on the paper that even when we get to the point later, he's a little betrayed by, hey, but we're doing this thing.
sentences.zh: 而且就像我说的，剧本里已经写得很清楚了，甚至当我们到了后面的情节，他会有点被背叛的感觉，心想，嘿，但我们不是在做这件事吗？

sentences.en: He needed to feel like, yeah, I used to do that.
sentences.zh: 他需要有一种感觉，没错，我以前也这么干过。

sentences.en: That's great.
sentences.zh: 那太棒了。

sentences.en: And I felt that that was something that I could bring is a little, that grounding big brother energy where Neil just had to be at a 10 all the time.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我能带来的是一种沉稳的大哥气场，而尼尔则需要时刻保持在十万伏特的兴奋状态。

sentences.en: Yeah, you know, it's occurring to me that a lot of How I Met Your Mother episodes are microcosms of the macrocosm.
sentences.zh: 是的，你知道，我突然意识到《老爸老妈浪漫史》的很多单集其实都是整个宏大主题的缩影。

sentences.en: And How I Met Your Mother, you could make an argument, the entire show is about growing up.
sentences.zh: 而且你完全可以说，《老爸老妈浪漫史》整部剧其实就是关于成长的。

sentences.en: It's about a transition from a kind of young adulthood, post-collegiate life into just a more of an adult kind of sense of responsibility, sense of your place in the world.
sentences.zh: 它讲的是从一种年轻的成年状态、大学毕业后的生活，过渡到更有责任感的成年心态，以及对自己在世界上所处位置的认知。

sentences.en: And, you know, James really models that for Barney.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，詹姆斯真的为巴尼树立了这样的榜样。

sentences.en: It's like he's crossed over some like Rubicon that Barney was like, you know, it's this kind of, I was talking with a friend of mine last night.
sentences.zh: 这就好像他跨越了某种卢比孔河，而巴尼当时就觉得，你知道，我昨晚还在跟一个朋友聊天。

sentences.en: And it's this great guy, Jamie, who I was friends with in my 20s, right?
sentences.zh: 那是个非常棒的家伙，叫杰米，我在二十多岁时跟他做过朋友，对吧？

sentences.en: And he's now, he just celebrated his 48th birthday.
sentences.zh: 他现在，他刚刚庆祝完48岁生日。

sentences.en: He's got two daughters.
sentences.zh: 他有两个女儿。

sentences.en: And we were talking about how, like, when we were younger, like, youth was our brand.
sentences.zh: 我们在聊到，当年的我们，年轻就是我们的招牌。

sentences.en: It was our whole thing we were offering New York City was like, we're young, we're here, we're excited.
sentences.zh: 我们在纽约市展现的全部特色就是：我们年轻，我们在这里，我们充满激情。

sentences.en: And then he was talking about a friend of his, this woman who is bummed.
sentences.zh: 然后他谈到了他的一个女性朋友，她感到很沮丧。

sentences.en: She was like, I didn't think aging would happen to me.
sentences.zh: 她说：“我没想到变老这种事会发生在我身上。”

sentences.en: I thought that somehow that was like a mistake other people made was like by getting older.
sentences.zh: 我还以为变老是其他人会犯的一种错误。

sentences.en: It's a glitch.
sentences.zh: 这只是个系统故障。

sentences.en: It's a glitch.
sentences.zh: 这只是个系统故障。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And it's like, that won't happen to us.
sentences.zh: 就好像，这种事不会发生在我们身上一样。

sentences.en: And there's, I don't know, there's just something like about the passage of time.
sentences.zh: 而且，我不知道，随着时间的流逝，总会有些奇妙的感悟。

sentences.en: And you have to, in some ways, cooperate with it rather than fight against it or it gets kind of ugly.
sentences.zh: 在某种程度上，你必须顺应它，而不是与它对抗，否则情况就会变得有点难看。

sentences.en: That's why I think shows like this are so successful.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我认为这样的剧集会如此成功。

sentences.en: Because you either have shows that are in the beginning stages, just like this is in terms of you graduate college and this much of life.
sentences.zh: 因为你要么看到那些刚开始阶段的剧，就像这部剧一样，讲的是你大学毕业后的人生阶段。

sentences.en: And then you have successful shows that are about the other part of that journey.
sentences.zh: 然后你也会看到那些聚焦于那段旅程另一部分的成功剧集。

sentences.en: Because it's coming and going.
sentences.zh: 因为岁月转瞬即逝。

sentences.en: And even now, you know, like as an adult, adult, adult with a 22-year-old kid and just that same thing that your friend was feeling is like, it surely couldn't happen to me.
sentences.zh: 甚至现在，你知道，作为一个真正成熟的大人，有着一个22岁的孩子，你也会产生和你朋友一样的感受，觉得这绝对不可能发生在我身上。

sentences.en: You feel that age.
sentences.zh: 你切切实实地感受到了岁月的痕迹。

sentences.en: And I think rather than fight against the machine, you have to go, oh, this is where I am now.
sentences.zh: 我想与其与命运抗争，你不如坦然接受：哦，这就是我现在的状态。

sentences.en: And it's cool to watch journeys like that happen.
sentences.zh: 而且看到这样的人生旅程展开，其实是一件很酷的事。

sentences.en: And I don't think that I could appreciate my place either physically or work-wise or anything if it wasn't for cool experiences like how I met your mother.
sentences.zh: 要不是因为有了《老爸老妈浪漫史》这样美妙的经历，我也不会如此珍视自己无论是身体上、工作上还是其他任何方面的现状。

sentences.en: When you are younger and you're feeling those things in that journey.
sentences.zh: 当你更年轻的时候，在那个旅程中体验着那些感受。

sentences.en: So the show is a microcosm because you're in one state when you're doing it.
sentences.zh: 所以这部剧是一个微观世界，因为你在进行时处于某种状态。

sentences.en: And then when you're older, looking back at it, you're like, God, look at that guy.
sentences.zh: 然后当你年纪更大时，回过头看，你会想，天哪，看看那家伙。

sentences.en: He had so much energy.
sentences.zh: 他曾经有那么多的精力。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊，是啊。

sentences.en: That's been one of the fun things for me.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，这一直是件很有趣的事。

sentences.en: And Craig is like the kind of the meta thing of like, we're older looking back on this time in our life.
sentences.zh: 而克雷格就像是一种元叙事一样，我们年纪大了，回首我们生活中的这段时光。

sentences.en: And the narrator on the show is older looking back on this very particular time in his life.
sentences.zh: 剧中的旁白也是年纪大了，回首他生命中这个非常特殊的时期。

sentences.zh: 就在两秒钟前你还在自我苛责，把这个分享给观众我认为简直是一项公益服务。

sentences.en: But I think that's the theater actor.
sentences.zh: 但我觉得这就是舞台剧演员的特质。

sentences.zh: 我觉得这就是舞台剧演员。

sentences.en: Because the theater actor just throws himself off the bridge and just trusts the bungee cord is going to catch him.
sentences.zh: 因为舞台剧演员就像是直接把自己从桥上跳下去，然后全心相信蹦极绳会接住他。

sentences.en: You know, it's like.
sentences.zh: 你知道，就像是。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.zh: 是的，因为你必须如此。

sentences.en: The voice that I hear all of the time that when I even teach, I say, look, this is what I'm hearing.
sentences.zh: 我无时无刻不在脑海中听到的那个声音，甚至在我教学时我都会说，听着，这就是我听到的声音。

sentences.en: It's always.
sentences.zh: 它总是。

sentences.en: But I've trained myself so much that you will not see that on the outside.
sentences.zh: 但我对自己进行了极其严格的训练，你在外表上绝对看不出来。

sentences.en: But I'm hearing that screaming.
sentences.zh: 但我脑子里全都是那种尖叫声。

sentences.en: And so I get to a point where like, well, I'm here.
sentences.zh: 所以我会到达这样一个状态，好吧，反正我已经在这了。

sentences.en: I'm in costume now.
sentences.zh: 我现在已经穿上戏服了。

sentences.en: Oh, there's an audience.
sentences.zh: 哦，有观众了。

sentences.en: Oh, there's cameras.
sentences.zh: 哦，有摄像机了。

sentences.en: You can't stop now.
sentences.zh: 你现在可停不下来了。

sentences.en: The time to stop would have been when you got the phone call weeks ago.
sentences.zh: 真要停的话，几周前接到电话的时候就该停了。

sentences.en: So you're here now.
sentences.zh: 所以你现在已经在这了。

sentences.en: So that's my way of.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是我。

sentences.en: And then once you jump and the bungee, then it's the most exhilarating feeling in the world.
sentences.zh: 然后一旦你纵身一跃，绳索绷紧，那将是世界上最让人兴奋的感觉。

sentences.en: And so doing that was great.
sentences.zh: 这样做效果确实很好。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: But I agree.
sentences.zh: 不过我赞同。

sentences.en: You have to travel through the valley of fear and panic.
sentences.zh: 你必须穿过恐惧与恐慌的峡谷。

sentences.en: I've never figured out a way to not do that.
sentences.zh: 我从来没找到过不经历这一遭的方法。

sentences.en: And in fact, sometimes I think it's there's a way to be almost too relaxed where you're not going to do your best work.
sentences.zh: 事实上，有时我觉得，如果放松到几乎过头，你就无法发挥出最好的水平。

sentences.en: Like there's a point of like tension and readiness that is almost athletic.
sentences.zh: 就像有一种带点紧绷和准备状态的时刻，几乎就像运动员一样。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Like it's like before a game, like you want to be loose, but you want to be like just at the edge, you know, get put me out there.
sentences.zh: 就像比赛前一样，你希望身体放松，但又想处于那种蓄势待发的边缘，你知道的，快让我上场吧。

sentences.en: You can't fool an audience.
sentences.zh: 你骗不了观众。

sentences.en: Some people can fool them just enough.
sentences.zh: 有些人能勉强糊弄他们一下。

sentences.en: But I truly believe this after decades of doing this on stage, even nightly now when I'm doing this show or when I'm touring.
sentences.zh: 但我真心这么认为，在舞台上经历了数十年之后，甚至现在每天晚上做这个节目或巡演时也是如此。

sentences.en: I love the use of tension.
sentences.zh: 我很喜欢这种紧绷感。

sentences.en: If the audience senses that you're there and you're prowling like a cat and you're ready to do your thing and you jump into whatever it is, they're there with you.
sentences.zh: 如果观众感觉到你在那里，像猫一样在暗中巡视，准备好大干一场，然后全身心投入到表演中，他们就会一直陪伴着你。

sentences.en: And just like when they're watching you on screen, they can feel the way that an edit made the scene build and the performances.
sentences.zh: 就像他们在屏幕上看着你一样，他们能感受到剪辑如何推动场景层层递进，以及演员的精彩演绎。

sentences.en: If you come out, you're like, oh, man, I just did Kansas City last night and I'm home.
sentences.zh: 如果你出场时一副无所谓的样子，心想，噢，伙计，我昨晚刚演完堪萨斯城，现在我回家了。

sentences.en: This is a cakewalk.
sentences.zh: 这简直小菜一碟。

sentences.en: As soon as you come out, laissez-faire, they know it.
sentences.zh: 只要你一出来摆出这种随性的姿态，他们一眼就能看穿。

sentences.en: Maybe they'll laugh.
sentences.zh: 也许他们还会笑。

sentences.en: They'll still be with you, but there's something missing.
sentences.zh: 他们依然会支持你，但就是少了点什么。

sentences.en: And I promised myself that years ago I said I would rather not do the thing I'm doing at that second than go out there and not feel that.
sentences.zh: 我几年前就向自己保证过，我说我宁愿不做当下正在做的事，也不愿带着这种不在状态的感觉登台。

sentences.en: Even on camera, you have to show up because it's in your eyes.
sentences.zh: 即使在镜头前，你也必须全情投入，因为你的眼神会出卖你。

sentences.en: Yeah, I just hear – it sounds like what I hear you describing is like being a professional, like just being a pro.
sentences.zh: 对，我只是觉得——听起来你描述的这种状态就像是个专业人士，就像真正的职业演员。

sentences.en: You know what I mean?
sentences.zh: 你知道我的意思吧？

sentences.en: And no one sustains a career as long as yours without being an absolute pro,
sentences.zh: 而且没有人能在不具备绝对职业素养的情况下，维持像你这么长的职业生涯，

sentences.en: but what people don't understand is that your level of talent and accomplishment has nothing to do with whether or not you're going to vomit in the stall before you go out there.
sentences.zh: 但人们不明白的是，你的才华和成就达到什么级别，跟你在上台前会不会在隔间里呕吐完全没有关系。

sentences.en: Like Maria Callas, like the greatest opera singer of the 20th century, apparently vomited before every performance from nerves.
sentences.zh: 就像玛丽亚·卡拉斯，20世纪最伟大的歌剧演唱家，据说她每次演出前都会因为紧张而呕吐。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: You know, there are people that just can –
sentences.zh: 你知道的，有些人就是能——

sentences.en: Yeah, it's like I think that in some ways your level of fear is commensurate with how much you care in a lot of ways.
sentences.zh: 对，我觉得在某种程度上，你的恐惧程度往往和你有多在乎成正比。

sentences.en: I do that before every podcast recording.
sentences.zh: 我每次录播客前都这样。

sentences.en: Sorry about it.
sentences.zh: 实在不好意思。

sentences.en: I don't look so good to hear it.
sentences.zh: 听到这个我可不太好受。

sentences.en: I was very nervous to see you today.
sentences.zh: 我今天来见你的时候非常紧张。

sentences.en: Just going around the gills.
sentences.zh: 整个人都局促不安。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Do you know another moment I loved?
sentences.zh: 你知道我喜欢的另一个片段是什么吗？

sentences.en: I love the dramatic stuff at the end between you and Barney.
sentences.zh: 我很喜欢你和巴尼在结尾时的那些戏剧性情节。

sentences.en: I love the fight you have.
sentences.zh: 我很喜欢你们之间的争吵。

sentences.en: I love the way when they reconcile, when you reveal – first of all, Neal's turn the moment he hears there's going to be a baby.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢他们和解的方式，当你揭晓的时候——首先，尼尔一听说要有孩子了，整个人态度立刻就变了。

sentences.en: It's one of my favorite Neal moments in the show, I think.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是尼尔在剧中我最喜欢的时刻之一。

sentences.en: Babies are Barney's kryptonite.
sentences.zh: 婴儿是巴尼的软肋。

sentences.en: It's true.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: That's true in the finale of the whole series, but we'll get there at some point.
sentences.zh: 整个剧集的结局里也是这样，不过我们稍后会聊到那里。

sentences.en: But like babies are Barney's vulnerability.
sentences.zh: 但婴儿就是巴尼的脆弱之处。

sentences.en: That made my wife laugh so hard.
sentences.zh: 这把我妻子逗得哈哈大笑。

sentences.en: There's going to be a baby?
sentences.zh: 要有个孩子了？

sentences.en: I was really moved by it too.
sentences.zh: 我也被深深打动了。

sentences.en: My eyes welled up in that scene because Barney's just so broken and he just wants to be important to his brother.
sentences.zh: 那场戏里我的眼眶都湿润了，因为巴尼实在是太绝望了，他只是想在自己哥哥心中占据重要地位。

sentences.en: He thinks he's going to lose his brother who's kind of, like we said, his father too in some ways.
sentences.zh: 他觉得自己会失去哥哥，而正如我们所说，在某种程度上哥哥也像是他的父亲。

sentences.en: His older brother's kind of his father.
sentences.zh: 他的大哥某种程度上就像他的父亲。

sentences.en: And the moment he hears that he's going to gain family, he's going to gain a new role of being Uncle Barney.
sentences.zh: 当他听到自己即将拥有家人，即将拥有巴尼叔叔这个新身份时，

sentences.en: And it's funny because the future narrator always refers to Uncle Barney.
sentences.zh: 这很有趣，因为未来的旁白总是提到巴尼叔叔。

sentences.en: Like that was his nickname in the group.
sentences.zh: 就像那是他在团体里的外号一样。

sentences.en: No, this is the moment he actually becomes Uncle Barney.
sentences.zh: 不，这就是他真正成为巴尼叔叔的时刻。

sentences.en: And it's like his greatest honor of his life.
sentences.zh: 这仿佛是他一生中最大的荣誉。

sentences.en: And he says, I'm going to be an uncle.
sentences.zh: 他说，我要当叔叔了。

sentences.en: And the way James says to him, the way you played it, Wayne, was, for the rest of your life.
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯对他说的那种方式，韦恩，你诠释的方式是，余生皆如此。

sentences.en: And you say it to him in this way that is like so lovely and such a gift to him.
sentences.zh: 你对他说这句话的方式是如此可爱，对他来说是一份如此厚重的礼物。

sentences.en: And he's about to cry.
sentences.zh: 他快要哭了。

sentences.en: I was sitting, I was watching it yesterday, knowing we were going to talk.
sentences.zh: 我昨天坐着看的时候，就知道我们要进行这次对话。

sentences.en: And I started to cry.
sentences.zh: 我开始哭了。

sentences.en: This great like replacement song, the Skyway by this awesome band, The Replacement, starts to play.
sentences.zh: 这首美妙的替代歌曲，由伟大的乐队The Replacements带来的《Skyway》开始播放。

sentences.en: It is such a beautiful moment that takes us into that flash forward a year later.
sentences.zh: 这是一个如此美好的时刻，将我们带入了闪回到一年后的镜头中。

sentences.en: We hint at where our characters are a year later.
sentences.zh: 我们暗示了角色们一年后的去向。

sentences.en: We say Marshall and Lily have gotten married in that year, which is a huge reveal.
sentences.zh: 我们说马歇尔和莉莉在那一年里已经结婚了，这是一个巨大的反转。

sentences.en: You're not sure what Ted and Robin status is.
sentences.zh: 你不确定泰德和罗宾的现状如何。

sentences.en: Robin and Ted, there's a little hint of neither of them are tired.
sentences.zh: 罗宾和泰德，有一个小小的暗示，表明他们两个都不累。

sentences.en: Why are they not tired?
sentences.zh: 为什么他们不累？

sentences.en: Why do they seem to have single stamina a year later?
sentences.zh: 为什么一年后他们看起来还像单身一样精力充沛？

sentences.en: Robin and Ted, are they now not together?
sentences.zh: 罗宾和泰德，他们现在不在一起了吗？

sentences.en: And that was like a little hint, a little breadcrumb for the audience to think about.
sentences.zh: 这就像是一个小暗示，给观众留下的一点思考线索。

sentences.en: But the warmth of Barney being an uncle to this little baby and like James giving him the ultimate gift of, here's more.
sentences.zh: 但巴尼作为这个小宝宝的叔叔所展现出的温情，以及詹姆斯送给他的终极大礼，也就是这些。

sentences.en: We didn't get to have a dad growing up, but I've given you a nephew.
sentences.zh: 我们在成长过程中没有爸爸，但我给了你一个侄子。

sentences.en: I was so moved by it.
sentences.zh: 我深受触动。

sentences.en: It was a really beautiful ending.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常美丽的结局。

sentences.en: Him being an uncle and loving babies, just like in the finale, like you said, I really feel that it is also because of his origin story.
sentences.zh: 他成为叔叔并且喜爱婴儿，就像在大结局里一样，正如你所说，我真的觉得这也是因为他的起源故事。

sentences.en: Growing up, James was his guy, always seeking dad, reading those letters or talking about, you know, oh, dad is this and dad's doing that.
sentences.zh: 在成长过程中，詹姆斯一直是他的主心骨，总是在寻找父亲，读那些信，或者谈论，你知道，哦，爸爸是这样的，爸爸在做那个。

sentences.en: That it's just natural that this guy would turn around and parent and want to parent that child or be able to protect that child because we all want to protect the little child that we couldn't protect.
sentences.zh: 所以这个人回过头来承担父职，想要抚养那个孩子，或者能够保护那个孩子，这是再自然不过的事，因为我们都想保护那个我们曾经无法保护的小孩。

sentences.en: Absolutely, it's that.
sentences.zh: 完全正确，就是这样。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah, so, so true.
sentences.zh: 对，对，太对了，太对了。

sentences.en: And also, I think James is doing some very good fathering of Barney in that moment.
sentences.zh: 而且，我觉得詹姆斯在那一刻对巴尼进行了很好的父爱教育。

sentences.en: Like he's actually stepping forward and going, it's time for all of us to grow up.
sentences.zh: 就像他实际上站出来说，我们所有人都该长大了。

sentences.en: I think sometimes when men are like, don't have a kind of role model, it doesn't have to be a father.
sentences.zh: 我觉得有时候当男人们没有某种榜样时，不一定非得是父亲。

sentences.en: It could be any sort of like strong male role model.
sentences.zh: 也可以是任何强有力的男性榜样。

sentences.en: They'll seek what it means to be a man from all sorts of like insane ideas, you know,
sentences.zh: 他们会从各种疯狂的想法中去寻找当男人的意义，你知道的，

sentences.en: they'll cobble it together from like all sorts of disparate sources that might not be the best kind of game plan, right?
sentences.zh: 他们会从各种零散的来源中拼凑出可能并非最佳应对方案的东西，对吧？

sentences.en: And, you know, part of a kind of side plot of this whole show is watching Barney like learn, it's really watching a bunch of people grow into their, you know, like assuming,
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，这部剧整体的一个支线剧情就是看巴尼学习，其实就是看一群人成长为他们的，你知道的，比方说承担起，

sentences.en: like growing out of their boy or their girl and into their adult persona, you know?
sentences.zh: 摆脱他们的男孩或女孩形象，成长为成年人的形象，你知道吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, we're all adolescents to like 30, basically, is the premise of this show.
sentences.zh: 是的，这部剧的核心前提就是我们基本上在30岁之前都处于青春期。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 完全同意。

sentences.en: Hey, Craig, it was, that was the voice of Megan Mullally, right?
sentences.zh: 嘿，克雷格，那是，那是梅根·马拉利的声音，对吧？

sentences.en: Doing the...
sentences.zh: 模仿那个...

sentences.en: I was just going to say, is everyone, does everyone know that trivia fun fact of what, you know, the Charlie Brown's parents, like, you know, you don't see her face,
sentences.zh: 我正想说，是不是每个人，大家都知道那个冷知识，就是查理·布朗的父母，你知道的，你看不到她的脸，

sentences.en: you don't see Barney and James's mom's face.
sentences.zh: 你看不到巴尼和詹姆斯的妈妈的脸。

sentences.en: That's Megan Mullally's voice.
sentences.zh: 那是梅根·马拉利的声音。

sentences.en: And it was uncredited, I think, at the time.
sentences.zh: 而且当时好像没有署名。

sentences.en: I think that only came out later because she was just like a friend of the show.
sentences.zh: 我想那是后来才曝光的，因为她只是剧组的朋友。

sentences.en: And she was like, yeah, I'll do that.
sentences.zh: 她就说，行啊，我来配。

sentences.en: Well, she, Megan had, remember, she had a talk show at that time.
sentences.zh: 而且，梅根当时，记得吗，她当时有一个脱口秀节目。

sentences.en: A talk show, and I think she banged it out.
sentences.zh: 一个脱口秀，我觉得她完成得非常出色。

sentences.en: Nick Offerman, her husband, was hanging around on set and was so nice to me.
sentences.zh: 她的丈夫尼克·奥弗曼当时在片场闲逛，对我特别好。

sentences.en: And I've, that was before he was on Parks and Rec or anything.
sentences.zh: 而且我，那是他演《公园与游憩》或别的什么之前的事了。

sentences.en: And I've always like loved the two of them because they were so good.
sentences.zh: 我一直都很喜欢他们俩，因为他们太棒了。

sentences.en: But then, I think our first all cast appearance was on the Megan Mullally show.
sentences.zh: 不过后来，我觉得我们全剧组第一次集体亮相是在梅根·马拉利秀上。

sentences.en: She invited all of us on.
sentences.zh: 她邀请了我们所有人去。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: So she was already like a bit of a friend of the show.
sentences.zh: 所以她当时就已经算是节目的半个朋友了。

sentences.en: I feel like she did it when, during that appearance.
sentences.zh: 我觉得她是那次，在那次节目的时候来的。

sentences.en: I feel like you guys went there and she banged out that line, those few lines for us as Barney's, as Barney and James' mom.
sentences.zh: 我觉得你们当时去了那儿，然后她为我们即兴说出了那句台词，那几句台词，演的是巴尼的，巴尼和詹姆斯的妈妈。

sentences.en: Hey, when, when, when Barney throws the phone at you and you have that like complicated, like juggling of the phone, was that, I can't remember,
sentences.zh: 嘿，当，当，当巴尼把电话朝你扔过来，然后你有一段那种复杂的，类似抛接电话的动作，那是，我记不清了，

sentences.en: is that planned or was that something that just happened?
sentences.zh: 那是计划好的，还是刚好发生的？

sentences.en: Like, remember you, you, the phone, like, you.
sentences.zh: 就像，记得你，你，那个电话，就像，你。

sentences.en: There's like a hot potato phone moment that was very impressively done.
sentences.zh: 有一个类似击鼓传花式的电话桥段，完成得非常惊艳。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: But it was such good, like physical prop business.
sentences.zh: 但那道具的处理和肢体动作真的太棒了。

sentences.en: And I was just wondering if you guys planned that.
sentences.zh: 我只是在想你们是不是排练过。

sentences.en: We didn't, I don't remember us planning it as such.
sentences.zh: 我们没有，我不记得我们做过这种排练。

sentences.en: It was like, we knew that, oh yeah, I'm going to get it and then maybe I'll do some, something with it.
sentences.zh: 就好像，我们知道，哦对，我要接住它，然后也许我会做点什么，弄点花样。

sentences.en: So, so I had to come up with it in the seconds, like, don't screw it up and drop the phone, but just make it look.
sentences.zh: 所以，所以我得在几秒钟内现挂，比如，别搞砸了把电话掉地上，但又得让它看起来。
